report: 初回機動で現在位置取得しなくなったよ
finding: The pinned Maps Lnce.onCreate(null) normally replays its launch Intent through an invoke-virtual ancestor reference. Dynamic dispatch reaches the hooked Lnce.onNewIntent before the first onResume. The v1.0.3 cancel-only handler therefore cancelled the original startup attempt during creation.
